intro: This page shows the record of one dataset laid out in the areas of ISAD(G), the general standard for archival description. Nothing here is new information: it is the same record as the dataset page, rearranged.

Next to every value is where it comes from. That matters more here than in a catalogue: some values were witnessed and fixed by the network, others are simply what the publisher typed in, and nobody has checked them.
tally: Of {total} entries: {chain} recorded on the chain, {publisher} stated by the publisher, {absent} not recorded.

chain.label: Recorded on the chain
chain.explain: Written by the network when it happened. Nobody can change it afterwards, including the publisher. The ↗ link opens the entry in the public ledger so you can check it yourself.

publisher.label: Stated by the publisher
publisher.explain: Typed in by whoever published the dataset. The chain keeps exactly what they sent, so it cannot be altered quietly later — but nobody checks that it is true.

absent.label: Not recorded
absent.explain: ISAD(G) asks for this, but the record does not have it. Often the Clio-X description form has no field for it.

areas.access: 3.4 Conditions of access and use area

values.extentHidden: Not disclosed. The list of files is encrypted; only the service that holds them can read it. The public record says how the material can be used, not how much of it there is.
values.noEvents: No change events found yet. The event index may still be catching up.

state.1: End of life — kept, no longer offered

values.stateNote: The publisher can change this status. Every change is itself recorded on the chain (see 3.2.3).
values.serviceCompute: Analyse in place. The data stays with the service that holds it. Approved analyses run there and only their results come out.
values.serviceAccess: Copy on request. Once a request is granted, the files can be downloaded.
values.timeoutNone: A granted request does not expire.
values.timeoutSeconds: A granted request is valid for {duration}.
values.priceFree: No charge (a small network fee may apply).
values.rawAlgorithmNo: Visitors cannot send their own code; only registered analysis tools run.
values.rawAlgorithmYes: Visitors may send their own code to run on the data.
values.networkNo: Analyses cannot reach the internet while running.
values.networkYes: Analyses may reach the internet while running.
values.trustedNone: The publisher has not listed specific analysis tools.
values.trustedCount: Analysis tools approved by the publisher: {count}.
values.trustedAny: No list of approved analysis tools in the record.
values.allowAll: Anyone with an account may make a request.
values.allowList: Only listed accounts may make a request ({count}).
values.enforced: These conditions are stated by the publisher and enforced by the service that holds the data.
values.useNone: No granted requests on the chain yet.
values.noLanguageField: The Clio-X description form has no field for language.
values.noTechnicalField: No technical requirements recorded for this dataset.
values.rulesNote: The machine-readable schema Clio-X uses for every record. It is not an archival standard; this page maps it onto ISAD(G).
values.dateMismatch: The description says it was last updated {declared}. The chain shows a later change on {recorded}. The stated date is typed by the publisher and is not checked; the chain date is.
values.archivistNote: Generated by Clio-X from the published record on {today}. No archivist has written or reviewed this description.
